bright.name: bright
bright.prompt: A woman in her early thirties with a clear, bright, mid-pitched voice that sits forward and projects well. Warm and engaging, smiling slightly, with real curiosity and momentum, like a top documentary YouTuber telling a gripping story. Crisp British-international diction, lively but controlled pace, natural emphasis on key words, short dramatic pauses before reveals. Never breathy, never sleepy, never announcer-like.

punchy.name: punchy
punchy.prompt: A confident woman in her thirties with a rich, resonant, medium-pitched voice and strong presence. Energetic and assured documentary storyteller: punchy delivery, clear projection, tight pacing that keeps viewers hooked, emphasising numbers and names, a touch of wry irony on twists. Neutral international English with a light British polish. Warm, articulate, never shouty or salesy.
